September 30, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-30-1971-54703

Pakistan’s Foreign department calls Indian temporary High Commissioner and demands for the four Pakistani staffs’ return. These staff members actually rebelled against the government and joined the Bangladeshi cause.

An article in Dutch daily De Tud says: The situation in East Pakistan is critically grievous. The number of refugees sheltering in India has increased to eight to ten millions. An inhumane condition has been created in East Pakistan by the Pakistani president.
